mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_SALARY_SUBMISSION_M m LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON u.user_sq = m.user_sq
SELECT m.*, u.user_nickname FROM TBL_SALARY_SUBMISSION_M m LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON u.user_sq = m.user_sq WHERE m.salary_submission_sq = #{salarySubmissionSq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_SALARY_SUBMISSION_M (user_sq, is_seed_yn, seed_nickname, employment_type, job_nm, career_bucket, region_nm, annual_salary, age_band, education_nm, company_size, company_type, position_nm, team_size, employment_subtype, remote_type, bonus_amount, stock_opt, job_change_count, company_nm, prev_annual_salary, job_changed_ym) VALUES (#{userSq}, #{isSeedYn}, #{seedNickname}, #{employmentType}, #{jobNm}, #{careerBucket}, #{regionNm}, #{annualSalary}, #{ageBand}, #{educationNm}, #{companySize}, #{companyType}, #{positionNm}, #{teamSize}, #{employmentSubtype}, #{remoteType}, #{bonusAmount}, #{stockOpt}, #{jobChangeCount}, #{companyNm}, #{prevAnnualSalary}, #{jobChangedYm})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_SALARY_SUBMISSION_M SET employment_type = #{employmentType}, job_nm = #{jobNm}, career_bucket = #{careerBucket}, region_nm = #{regionNm}, annual_salary = #{annualSalary}, age_band = #{ageBand}, education_nm = #{educationNm}, company_size = #{companySize}, company_type = #{companyType}, position_nm = #{positionNm}, team_size = #{teamSize}, employment_subtype = #{employmentSubtype}, remote_type = #{remoteType}, bonus_amount = #{bonusAmount}, stock_opt = #{stockOpt}, job_change_count = #{jobChangeCount}, company_nm = #{companyNm}, prev_annual_salary = #{prevAnnualSalary}, job_changed_ym = #{jobChangedYm} WHERE salary_submission_sq = #{salarySubmissionSq}
UPDATE TBL_SALARY_SUBMISSION_M SET salary_submission_is_deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE salary_submission_sq = #{salarySubmissionSq}
